English: African marigold (Tagetes erecta) – mbangimwitu. Use against: bacteria, fungi, nematodes, insects (ants, beetles and many others). Preparation: crush 100-200g of the leaves, roots or flowers, pour on 1 litre of boiling water, stir, and soak for 24 hours, then add 1 litre of cold water. Spray on plants or into the soil.
Kiswahili: African marigold / Mbangimwitu (Tagetes erecta). Inazuia: bacteria, fungi, nematodes, wadudu (ants, beetles na wadudu wengine wengi). Kutayarisha: ponda gramu 100-200 ya matawi, mizizi na maua; mwaga kwa lita moja ya maji yaliyochemka; lowa kwa masaa ishirini na nne; ongeza lita moja ya maji baridi; nyunyiza kwa mimea au mchanga.
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=magazine; urgency=low; source_pair=true

English: When crops are damaged during or after harvest, they quickly spoil. You may not be able to sell your damaged produce, or you may be forced to sell at a reduced price. On the other hand, if you can reduce your losses, you can increase your income. At harvest time, when picking fruits, be careful not to knock them off the tree and onto the ground. If fruit falls, it gets bruised, disease and insects attack, and the fruit will quickly spoil. If you reduce the number of falls, you will have high quality produce to sell.
Kiswahili: Mazao yanapojeruhiwa wakati wa kuvuna au mara baada ya mavuno, yanaharibika kwa haraka. Unaweza kushindwa kuuza mazao yaliyoharibika au kujeruhiwa, na wakati mwingine ukalazimika kuyauza kwa bei ndogo. Kwa upande mwingine, kama utafanikiwa kupunguza hasara, unaweza pia kuongeza kipato chako. Wakati wa mavuno, unapokuwa ukichuma matunda, kuwa mwangalifu, usiyagonge kwenye mti au kuyaacha yakaanguka ardhini. Kama tunda likianguka chini, linaweza kupata michubuko, magonjwa na vijidudu vinalishambulia, na tunda huharibika. Kama utaweza kuzuia idadi ya matunda yanayoanguka chini, utakuwa na bidhaa bora sokoni.

English: When crops are damaged during or after harvest, they quickly spoil, so you may be forced to sell at a reduced price. The best time to harvest fruits and vegetables is in the morning — wait until the dew has evaporated, then harvest before the day gets too hot. Harvesting later in the day leaves fruits and vegetables wilted or limp, with more disease and insect problems. Harvest in the morning for firmer, fresher produce.
Kiswahili: Matunda yanapokuwa yamejeruhiwa wakati wa kuvuna ama baada ya kuvuna, huharibika kwa haraka, hivyo unaweza kulazimika kuyauza kwa bei ya chini. Muda mzuri wa kuvuna matunda na mboga ni asubuhi — subiri mpaka umande umekauka, halafu vuna kabla jua halijawa kali. Ukivuna wakati wa jua kali, matunda na mboga zinaweza kusinyaa au kunyauka, na kushambuliwa zaidi na magonjwa au wadudu. Vuna asubuhi ili upate mazao mazuri na imara.

Kiswahili: Wakulima wanaweza kuongeza mavuno ya mtama na mtama kwa faida kwa kutumia mbolea pamoja na mbinu za kikaboni na asili ambazo huhifadhi na kuzingatia unyevu wa udongo na vitu vya kikaboni.

Kiswahili: Ikiwa mvua zinatabiriwa kunyesha kiwango cha chini ya kiwango cha kawaida, chagua aina za mazao yanayostahimili ukame kwa eneo lako, au badilisha mazao na kupanda mazao yanayostahimili ukame. Kwa mfano, badala ya mahindi unaweza kupanda mtama au uwele.

English: For rainfed agriculture, land should ideally be prepared at least two weeks before planting, with timing depending on when the rainy season is forecast to start, the crops being grown, and the topography.
Kiswahili: Kwa kilimo kinachotegemea mvua, shamba linapaswa kutayarishwa angalau wiki mbili kabla ya kupanda, kulingana na wakati msimu wa mvua unatarajiwa kuanza, zao litakalopandwa, na hali ya ardhi.

English: If rains are predicted as normal, apply organic fertilizer one to two weeks before planting in bunds or by spreading, followed by shallow tillage; if rains are below normal, apply organic fertilizer two to three weeks before planting.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mvua ni za kiwango cha kawaida, tumia mbolea ya asili wiki moja hadi mbili kabla ya kupanda kwenye malundo au kwa kusambaza kukifuatiwa na upaliliaji mwepesi; ikiwa mvua zinatabiriwa kunyesha chini ya kiwango cha kawaida, tumia mbolea ya asili wiki mbili hadi tatu kabla ya kupanda.
Source: CGSpace/CCAFS-IITA "Climate smart agriculture: top ten decisions to make with weather info" poster - OCR-extracted 2026-07-15 with tesseract (eng/swa+eng), aligned by matching section headings between EN+SW versions (cgspace.cgiar.org items 62fd7239.../c4d42102...)

English: Wait for the rains to start, and plant when the soil is moist enough - at least 20mm of rainfall over four consecutive days, or two days of heavy rain - or follow the advice from meteorology.
Kiswahili: Subiri hadi mvua zianze kunyesha, na panda wakati ardhi ina unyevu wa kutosha - angalau milimita 20 za mvua kwa siku nne mfululizo, au siku mbili za mvua kubwa - au fuata ushauri wa hali ya hewa.

English: Weeding can be done manually or with herbicides; when using herbicides, use the correct product, wear the correct protective clothing, and follow correct disposal of containers. Weed more often when rains are heavy, and less often when rains are light.
Kiswahili: Palizi inaweza kufanywa kwa kutumia mikono au kwa dawa ya kuua magugu; wakati wa kutumia dawa za kuua magugu, tumia dawa inayofaa, vaa nguo sahihi za kujikinga, na uzingatie utupaji sahihi wa vyombo vya dawa baada ya kutumia. Wakati wa mvua nyingi, palilia magugu mara nyingi zaidi, na ikiwa mvua ni chache, punguza upaliliaji.

English: For grains and legumes, harvest when the crop is completely dry; do not dry the harvest on bare soil, but spread a mat and store it in a dry, cool place. If rains are predicted, consider harvesting early and drying quickly.
Kiswahili: Kwa nafaka na mikunde, ni muhimu kuvuna wakati mazao yamekauka kabisa; usikaushe kwenye mchanga, bali tandaza mkeka na hifadhi mavuno katika sehemu kavu na baridi. Ikiwa mvua zinategemewa kunyesha, fikiria kuvuna mapema na kukausha haraka.

English: Whenever possible, it is advised not to sell immediately after harvest when prices are low; harvest appropriately, store correctly, and sell when prices are higher.
Kiswahili: Inashauriwa, inapowezekana, kutouza mara tu baada ya mavuno wakati bei ziko chini; vuna ipasavyo, hifadhi vizuri, na uuze wakati bei ziko juu.

English: Based on the seasonal rainfall forecast, adopt appropriate soil and water conservation measures: if rains are predicted above normal, focus on controlling erosion, protecting crops from flooding, and water harvesting; if below normal, focus on conserving soil moisture. If your land is sloping, add contour bunds to prevent soil erosion.
Kiswahili: Kulingana na utabiri wa msimu wa mvua, zingatia mbinu sahihi za kuhifadhi udongo na maji: ikiwa mvua zinatarajiwa kuwa nyingi kuliko kawaida, zingatia kudhibiti mmomonyoko wa udongo, kulinda mazao dhidi ya mafuriko, na kuvuna maji; ikiwa mvua zitakuwa chini ya kawaida, zingatia kuhifadhi unyevu wa udongo. Ikiwa ardhi yako iko mteremkoni, jenga matuta ili kuzuia mmomonyoko wa udongo.

English: Fertilizer can be organic, such as manure, or inorganic, or a mix of both; select the right fertilizer mix based on your soil, the crops you are growing, and the seasonal forecast.
Kiswahili: Mbolea inaweza kuwa ya asili, mfano samadi, au ya viwandani, au mchanganyiko wa aina zote mbili; chagua mchanganyiko sahihi wa mbolea kulingana na rutuba ya udongo wako, mazao unayopanda, na utabiri wa msimu.

English: Some pests and diseases occur when the weather is dry and others when there is heavy rain, so understand how the dynamics of major pests and diseases affecting your crops relate to the weather forecast, and identify which pesticides may be needed, where to obtain them, and how to use them correctly.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya wadudu waharibifu na magonjwa hutokea wakati hali ya hewa ni kavu na wengine hutokea wakati kuna mvua nyingi, hivyo elewa jinsi mienendo ya wadudu na magonjwa makuu ya mazao yako inavyohusiana na utabiri wa hali ya hewa, kisha bainisha viuatilifu vinavyohitajika, mahali vinapopatikana, na jinsi ya kuvitumia kwa usahihi.

English: To inoculate soybean seed, mix a sugar-water sticker solution, coat the seed evenly with it, then add the rhizobium inoculant and mix gently until every seed is covered; protect the inoculated seed from direct sunlight and keep it in the shade until you plant it.
Kiswahili: Ili kuchanja mbegu ya soya, changanya suluhisho la stika ya maji ya sukari, paka mbegu sawasawa nayo, kisha ongeza chanjo ya rhizobium na changanya kwa upole hadi kila mbegu ifunikiwe; Linda mbegu iliyochanjwa kutoka kwa jua moja kwa moja na kuiweka kwenye kivuli hadi uipande.

English: Common pests affecting soybean in Ethiopia are the African bollworm, cutworm, green stink bug, and aphid; leaf damage alone is unlikely to reduce yield and does not need spraying, but from flowering onwards soybean becomes attractive to pod-sucking bugs that can seriously reduce seed quality.
Kiswahili: Wadudu wa kawaida wanaoathiri soya nchini Ethiopia ni bollworm ya Kiafrika, minyoo, mdudu wa kijani kibichi, na aphid; Uharibifu wa majani pekee hauwezekani kupunguza mavuno na hauhitaji kunyunyiziwa dawa, lakini kutoka kwa maua na kuendelea soya inavutia mende wanaonyonya ganda ambao wanaweza kupunguza sana ubora wa mbegu.

English: Climbing bean varieties yield more per unit of land than bush varieties but need staking for support; the highest yields come from stakes at least 175cm long, using at least 20,000 stakes per hectare, started two weeks after germination.
Kiswahili: Aina ya maharagwe ya kupanda huzaa zaidi kwa kila kitengo cha ardhi kuliko aina za kichaka lakini zinahitaji staking kwa msaada; mavuno ya juu huja kutoka kwa stakes angalau 175cm ya urefu, kwa kutumia stakes angalau 20,000 kwa hekta, ilianza wiki mbili baada ya kilimo.
Source: CGSpace/N2Africa "Better beans through good agricultural practices" leaflet, July 2014, For farmers in Ethiopia (CC-licensed) - staking climbing beans excerpt, 2026-07-15 (cgspace.cgiar.org item 3be2c6b5-0c6c-4078-b7c7-8edc90503d3a, handle 10568/76317)

English: Bean stem maggot can be controlled through early planting, crop rotation, earthing up soil around the stem during weeding, using tolerant varieties, or treating seed with a systemic insecticide before planting.
Kiswahili: Funza wa shina la maharagwe yanaweza kudhibitiwa kupitia upandaji mapema, mzunguko wa mazao, kuweka udongo kuzunguka shina wakati wa kupalilia, kutumia aina zinazostahimili, au kutibu mbegu kwa dawa ya kuua wadudu kabla ya kupanda.

English: Test the seeds for germination and plant only when germination is above 80%.
Kiswahili: Jaribu mbegu ya soya kama inamea kabla ya kupanda ili kuthibitisha kwamba asilimia zaidi ya 80 inamea.

Kiswahili: Panda kwa wakati ufaao, hakikisha mchanga una unyevu wa kutosha hasa wakati wa mvua za mwanzo. Mizizi ya soya haiwezi kustahimili mchanga mkavu ama mchanga wenye maji mengi.

Kiswahili: Tumia dawa ya kuzuia magonjwa iliyopendekezwa, kwa kiwango kilichopendekezwa, wakati soya inapoanza kuweka maua. Rudia kunyunyizia dawa, kulingana na maagizo, kwa kawaida siku 21 baada ya kunyunyiza mara ya kwanza.
Source: N2Africa "Best practices to maintain high yields and grain quality of soybean" checklist, for farmers in west Kenya - genuine EN+Swahili bilingual document (n2africa.org/sites/default/files/Best practice_soybean_English-Kiswahili.pdf)

English: Harvest early when 90-100% of pods are brown and dry, but before they become brittle and shatter.
Kiswahili: Vuna mapema wakati asilimia 90 hadi 100 ya mizoga imekauka na kubadilika kuwa rangi ya hudhurungi, lakini kabla haijaanza kupasuka.
Source: N2Africa "Best practices to maintain high yields and grain quality of soybean" checklist, for farmers in west Kenya - genuine EN+Swahili bilingual document (n2africa.org/sites/default/files/Best practice_soybean_English-Kiswahili.pdf)

Kiswahili: Ondoa uchafu kwenye mbegu na ukaushe hadi unyevu ufike asilimia 11-12; soya zenye unyevu zaidi ya asilimia 13% huenda zikaoza, na ukikausha zaidi ya asilimia 11 mbegu zitapasuka.
Source: N2Africa "Best practices to maintain high yields and grain quality of soybean" checklist, for farmers in west Kenya - genuine EN+Swahili bilingual document (n2africa.org/sites/default/files/Best practice_soybean_English-Kiswahili.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=checklist; urgency=medium; source_pair=true

English: Store dry, clean grain only in clean bags - never recycled fertilizer, pesticide, or other chemical bags - and keep it in a cool, dry, ventilated place.
Kiswahili: Weka nafaka safi na iliyokauka kwenye magunia safi tu - usitumie magunia yaliyotumika kubeba mbolea, dawa za wadudu, au kemikali nyingine - na uhifadhi mahali penye ubaridi, ukavu, na hewa ya kutosha.
Source: N2Africa "Best practices to maintain high yields and grain quality of soybean" checklist, for farmers in west Kenya - genuine EN+Swahili bilingual document (n2africa.org/sites/default/files/Best practice_soybean_English-Kiswahili.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=checklist; urgency=low; source_pair=true

English: Harvest the nuts when they are well ripe; Harvesting prematurely leads to a loss of yield, and late harvesting causes the nuts to become poisoned by the fungus (aflatoxin).
Kiswahili: Vuna karanga wakati zimekomaa vizuri; kuvuna kabla ya wakati kunasababisha kupoteza mavuno, na kuchelewa kuvuna kunasababisha karanga kuingiwa na sumu kuvu (aflatoxin).
Source: Makutupora Agricultural Research Institute / N2Africa "Ongeza mavuno ya karanga kwa kutumia mbinu bora za kilimo" (Tanzania groundnut brochure) - Swahili-original, no English source exists (n2africa.org/sites/default/files/Groundnut Brochure, Tanzania.pdf)

English: Store well-dried nuts in clean sacks and a clean, dry and moisture-free warehouse; use a biological remedy such as Aflasafe, if available, following the advice of specialists, to control fungal poisoning.

Kiswahili: Dhibiti Fall Armyworm kwa kuponda wingi wa mayai na kuokota mabuu wachanga kwa mkono kabla ya kuingia kwenye whorl ya mahindi; Epuka matumizi ya dawa ya kemikali isiyo ya lazima, ambayo ni ya gharama kubwa na inaweza kuua wanyama wanaowinda wanyama wengine ambao husaidia kudhibiti wadudu.
Source: FAO, "How to Manage Fall Armyworm: A Quick Guide for Smallholders" (FAW Guidance Note 4), CA0435EN/1/07.18 (openknowledge.fao.org/server/api/core/bitstreams/359d03ae-27c3-4257-a906-a4e155c2a2b1/content)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=FAO technical guidance note; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.474

English: To manage tomato wilt (kiwotoka), rotate tomatoes with maize, beans, or sweet potatoes for several years, plant tomatoes in a different plot each year, try different varieties to find resistant ones, and pull up and burn any wilting plant you find.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti mnyauko wa nyanya (kiwotoka), zungusha nyanya na mahindi, maharagwe, au viazi vitamu kwa miaka kadhaa, panda nyanya katika shamba tofauti kila mwaka, jaribu aina tofauti ili kupata sugu, na uvute na uchome mmea wowote unaonyauka unaopata.
Source: CABI Plantwise, "Tomato wilt or kiwotoka" Factsheet for Farmers, Created in Uganda, July 2006 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20103326447.pdf), CC-BY-SA 4.0
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Uganda; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.45

English: To control tomato red spider mite, avoid continuous tomato cropping, remove and destroy crop residues before replanting, wash and sun-dry stakes and twine before reuse, inspect crop borders regularly, and spray water on plants to reduce the dust that mites thrive in.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti utitiri wa buibui nyekundu wa nyanya, epuka kupanda nyanya kuendelea, ondoa na uharibu mabaki ya mazao kabla ya kupanda tena, osha na kausha vigingi na kamba kabla ya kutumia tena, kagua mipaka ya mazao mara kwa mara, na nyunyiza maji kwenye mimea ili kupunguza vumbi ambalo utitiri hustawi.
Source: CABI Plantwise, "Tomato red spider mite" Factsheet for Farmers, Created in Kenya, October 2012 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20137804187.pdf), CC-BY-SA 4.0
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Kenya; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.648

English: To manage potato bacterial wilt, uproot and remove infected plants from the field, buy certified disease-free seed potatoes, rotate potatoes/tomatoes/peppers/eggplants with maize, bananas, beans, cassava, or millet, remove all volunteer potato tubers after harvest, and keep field tools clean.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti mnyauko wa bakteria ya viazi, kung'oa na kuondoa mimea iliyoambukizwa shambani, nunua viazi vya mbegu vilivyoidhinishwa visivyo na magonjwa, zungusha viazi/nyanya/pilipili/biringanya na mahindi, ndizi, maharagwe, mihogo, au mtama, ondoa mizizi yote ya viazi ya kujitolea baada ya kuvuna, na kuweka zana za shambani safi.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Potato bacteria wilt", Created in Rwanda, May 2012, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20127801777.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Rwanda; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.872

English: To reduce Brown Leaf Spot in cassava, use good, healthy planting stock, destroy infected crop husks after harvest, and plant early so the crop grows vigorously; if healthy planting material isn't available, dip cassava stems in a diluted fungicide before planting.
Kiswahili: Ili kupunguza jani la Brown katika muhogo, tumia mbegu nzuri za kupanda, uharibu maganda ya mazao yaliyoambukizwa baada ya mavuno, na uote mapema ili mmea ukue kwa nguvu; ikiwa vifaa vyenye afya havipatikani, chovya mashina ya muhogo katika kuvu iliyotiwa chumvi kabla ya kupanda.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Brown Leaf Spot (BLS) of Cassava", Created in Uganda, August 2012, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20137804388.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Uganda; qa_tool=opus; qa_roundtrip=0.33

English: To free cassava cuttings of mealybugs before planting, heat water until it is too hot to hold a finger in for more than five seconds (about 60C), then dip the cuttings in this hot water for one minute only - do not soak longer, as this can kill the cuttings too.
Kiswahili: Ili kuachilia vipandikizi vya mihogo ya mealybugs kabla ya kupanda, joto maji hadi iwe moto sana kushikilia kidole kwa zaidi ya sekunde tano (karibu 60C), kisha chovya vipandikizi kwenye maji haya ya moto kwa dakika moja tu - usiloweke kwa muda mrefu, kwani hii inaweza kuua vipandikizi pia.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Warm water treatment of cassava mealybug", Created in Zambia, August 2013, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20147801347.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Zambia; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.812

English: To control cassava mosaic disease, check plants weekly for the first 2-3 months after planting; when you find diseased plants, uproot them by hand once a week, replace them immediately with healthy cuttings, and burn the uprooted diseased plants after sun-drying them away from the field.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti ugonjwa wa mosaic ya muhogo, angalia mimea kila wiki kwa miezi 2-3 ya kwanza baada ya kupanda; Unapopata mimea yenye ugonjwa, ing'oa kwa mkono mara moja kwa wiki, ubadilishe mara moja na vipandikizi vyenye afya, na uchome mimea iliyong'olewa baada ya kukausha jua mbali na shamba.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Control of cassava mosaic disease by uprooting", Created in Tanzania, October 2014, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20157800492.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Tanzania; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.92

English: To trap snails away from your vegetables, place piles of fresh pawpaw leaves or cassava peels (about the size of a football) near your plots in the evening, about half a metre to a metre from the plants; collect and destroy the snails gathered on the traps early the next morning.
Kiswahili: Ili kunasa konokono mbali na mboga zako, weka marundo ya majani safi ya pawpaw au maganda ya mihogo (karibu saizi ya mpira wa miguu) karibu na viwanja vyako jioni, karibu nusu mita hadi mita kutoka kwa mimea; kukusanya na kuharibu konokono waliokusanyika kwenye mitego mapema asubuhi iliyofuata.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Pawpaw leaves and cassava peels to trap snails", Created in Zambia, December 2014, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20167800153.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=low; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Zambia; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.927

English: To manage mango bacterial black spot, plant tolerant varieties such as Heidi or Sensation, plant windbreaks to reduce rain splash, burn infected fruits and dead branches, prune to improve airflow and light in the canopy, and apply copper sprays or fungicides regularly.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti doa nyeusi la bakteria ya embe, panda aina zinazostahimili kama vile Heidi au Sensation, panda vizuizi vya upepo ili kupunguza mvua, kuchoma matunda yaliyoambukizwa na matawi yaliyokufa, kupogoa ili kuboresha mtiririko wa hewa na mwanga kwenye dari, na kupaka dawa za shaba au fungicides mara kwa mara.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Mango Bacterial Black Spot", Created in Uganda, August 2012, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20137804392.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Uganda; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.218

English: When using legume seed inoculant: use the correct inoculant for each legume species and check the expiration date; protect it from sun and heat, storing between 4-26C; and keep it in tightly closed bags, removing it only with clean utensils.
Kiswahili: Unapotumia chanjo ya mbegu za mikunde: tumia chanjo ifaayo kwa kila aina ya mikunde na angalia muda wa kuharibika; kinga chanjo kutoka kwa jua na joto, ihifadhi kwa joto la 4-26C; na iweke kwenye mkoba uliofungwa kikamilifu, ukiondoa kwa chombo kisafi tu.
Source: N2Africa, "Biological Nitrogen Fixation and Grain Legume Enterprise: Guidelines for N2Africa Master Farmers" (CIAT-TSBF/FORMAT, 2010) - English (n2africa.org/sites/default/files/Master%20farmer%20guidelines_BNF%20-%20GL%20enterprise%20s_0.pdf) + Kiswahili edition (n2africa.org/sites/default/files/Master%20farmer%20guidelines_BNF-GL_Kiswahili%20version%20incl%20cover-S_0.pdf), "Utumizi bora wa chanjo cha mikunde" checklist
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=extension guideline booklet; urgency=medium

English: When inoculating legume seeds: use a sticker such as gum arabic to bind the inoculant to the seed (smaller seeds need more sticker), use no less than 10g of inoculant per kg of seed, and inoculate just before planting, covering the seed with soil soon after to protect it from sun and drying.
Kiswahili: Unapochanja mbegu za mikunde: tumia gamu kama Gum Arabic kushikisha chanjo kwenye mbegu (mbegu ndogo huitaji gamu nyingi), tumia chanjo isiyopungua gramu 10 kwa kilo ya mbegu, na chanja mbegu kabla tu ya kupanda, ukizifunika mchangani mara tu baada ya kupanda kuzikinga na jua na kukauka.
Source: N2Africa, "Biological Nitrogen Fixation and Grain Legume Enterprise: Guidelines for N2Africa Master Farmers" (CIAT-TSBF/FORMAT, 2010) - English (n2africa.org/sites/default/files/Master%20farmer%20guidelines_BNF%20-%20GL%20enterprise%20s_0.pdf) + Kiswahili edition (n2africa.org/sites/default/files/Master%20farmer%20guidelines_BNF-GL_Kiswahili%20version%20incl%20cover-S_0.pdf), "Utumizi bora wa chanjo cha mikunde" checklist
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=extension guideline booklet; urgency=medium

English: When harvesting and drying groundnuts, do not harvest in the rain or pile the pods into heaps that stay damp, since this encourages mould and dangerous aflatoxin contamination; handle pods carefully to avoid splitting the seeds, which lowers their sale value.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa kuvuna na kukausha karanga, usivune kwenye mvua au kurundika maganda kwenye lundo ambalo hukaa unyevunyevu, kwani hii inahimiza ukungu na uchafuzi hatari wa aflatoxin; Shughulikia maganda kwa uangalifu ili kuepuka kugawanya mbegu, ambayo hupunguza thamani yao ya mauzo.
Source: N2Africa Outreach Project, "Grain Legume Processing Handbook: Value Addition to Bean, Cowpea, Groundnut and Soybean by Small-Scale African Farmers" (Woomer et al.) (n2africa.org/sites/default/files/Handbook%20Grain%20Legume%20Processing%20S_0.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=extension handbook; urgency=high; translation=team; source_lang=en; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.572

English: As part of Zambia's national drought response, farming households in affected areas are being provided with seeds and planting materials for early-maturing, drought-resistant crops (including vegetables, maize, mixed beans, and cowpeas), and encouraged to diversify crops to reduce reliance on staples and improve dietary diversity.
Kiswahili: Kama sehemu ya mwitikio wa ukame wa kitaifa wa Zambia, kaya za wakulima katika maeneo yaliyoathiriwa zinapewa mbegu na vifaa vya kupanda kwa mazao yanayokomaa mapema, yanayostahimili ukame (pamoja na mboga, mahindi, maharagwe mchanganyiko, na mbaazi), na kuhimizwa kubadilisha mazao ili kupunguza utegemezi wa chakula kikuu na kuboresha utofauti wa lishe.
Source: Zambia Drought Response Appeal (May-December 2024), Agriculture sector response strategy, co-led by WFP/FAO with the Zambian government's DMMU-coordinated national drought response (unocha.org/attachments/9890d85b-000f-4eb3-81cf-7e0984a452ea/Zambia%20Drought%20Response%20Appeal%20_06052024%20FINAL%20V2.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=government/UN drought response appeal; urgency=high; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Zambia; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.757

English: As part of Zambia's national drought response, affected agro-pastoral communities are receiving livestock disease surveillance and management support, supplementary animal feed, and rehabilitated dams, boreholes, and weirs to secure water access for irrigation and livestock.
Kiswahili: Kama sehemu ya kukabiliana na ukame wa taifa nchini Zambia, jamii za kilimo na malisho zilizoathiriwa zinapata msaada wa ufuatiliaji na usimamizi wa magonjwa ya mifugo, chakula cha ziada cha wanyama, na madaraja yaliyosafishwa, mashimo, na vibanda vya maji ili kuhakikisha upatikanaji wa maji kwa ajili ya umwagiliaji na mifugo.
Source: Zambia Drought Response Appeal (May-December 2024), Agriculture sector response strategy, co-led by WFP/FAO with the Zambian government's DMMU-coordinated national drought response (unocha.org/attachments/9890d85b-000f-4eb3-81cf-7e0984a452ea/Zambia%20Drought%20Response%20Appeal%20_06052024%20FINAL%20V2.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=government/UN drought response appeal; urgency=high; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Zambia; qa_tool=nllb; qa_roundtrip=0.491

English: When practicing companion planting, choose crops carefully: for example, intercrop maize with legumes since beans fix nitrogen that maize needs, but avoid pairing two 'heavy feeder' crops like maize and sunflower that compete heavily for the same nutrients.
Kiswahili: Unapofanya kilimo mseto, chagua mazao kwa uangalifu: kwa mfano, changanya mahindi na mikunde kwani maharagwe huweka naitrojeni ambayo mahindi huhitaji, lakini epuka kuchanganya mazao mawili 'yanayohitaji virutubisho vingi' kama mahindi na alizeti ambayo hushindania virutubisho sawa.
Source: Farm Radio International, "Backgrounder: Benefits of crop companion planting and mutualism" (scripts.farmradio.fm/radio-script/backgrounder-benefits-crop-companion-planting-mutualism/, Swahili: scripts.farmradio.fm/sw/mwongozo-wa-redio/taarifa-za-awali-faida-za-upandaji-wa-mazao-mbalimbali-kwa-njia-ya-mseto/)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=Farm Radio International backgrounder

English: To maintain healthy soil in conservation agriculture, cover at least 30% of your land with crop residues or cover crops; this reduces weeds, prevents erosion of fertile topsoil, and conserves soil moisture, especially in dry regions. Leguminous cover crops like mucuna, sun hemp, and lablab beans can also cut chemical fertilizer use by 60-80% without lowering yields.
Kiswahili: Ili kutunza udongo vizuri katika kilimo hifadhi, funika angalau asilimia 30 ya shamba lako kwa mabaki ya mazao au mazao funika; hii hupunguza magugu, huzuia mmomonyoko wa udongo wenye rutuba, na kuhifadhi unyevu wa udongo, hasa katika maeneo yenye ukame. Mazao funika ya jamii ya mikunde kama mukuna, sunhemp, na lablab pia yanaweza kupunguza matumizi ya mbolea za kemikali kwa asilimia 60-80 bila kupunguza mavuno.
Source: Farm Radio International, "Backgrounder: Using permanent soil cover in conservation agriculture" (scripts.farmradio.fm/radio-script/backgrounder-using-permanent-soil-cover-conservation-agriculture/, Swahili: scripts.farmradio.fm/sw/mwongozo-wa-redio/utangulizi-utumiaji-wa-mazao-funika-kwenye-kilimo-hifadhi/)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=Farm Radio International backgrounder

English: To dry rice seed without spoiling it, build a simple raised table from wood or bamboo instead of drying on the ground; air moves freely under the seed so it dries faster and stays clean, and the table can be quickly carried indoors when it rains.
Kiswahili: Ili kukausha mbegu ya mchele bila kuiharibu, jenga meza iliyoinuliwa kutoka kwa mbao au mianzi badala ya kukaushwa ardhini; hewa husonga kwa uhuru chini ya mbegu hiyo ili iwe kavu zaidi na kubaki ikiwa safi, na meza yaweza kubebwa upesi ndani ya nyumba inaponyesha.
Source: Farm Radio International, "Dry rice seed off the ground to ensure top quality" (scripts.farmradio.fm/radio-script/dry-rice-seed-off-the-ground-to-ensure-top-quality/)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=Farm Radio International script; urgency=low; translation=team; source_lang=en; qa_tool=opus; qa_roundtrip=0.736

English: To manage cassava mosaic disease: plant only cuttings showing no signs of infection, taken from a clean disease-free field; uproot and bury any plant that develops symptoms as soon as you see them; plant tolerant varieties (in Malawi: Sauti, Sagonja, Yizaso, Chamandanda); and rotate crops to prevent the disease building up in the soil.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti ugonjwa wa mosaic ya muhogo: panda vipandikizi tu visivyo na dalili za maambukizi, vilivyochukuliwa kutoka kwa shamba safi lisilo na magonjwa; kung'oa na kuzika mmea wowote unaopata dalili mara tu unapoziona; aina zinazostahimili mimea (nchini Malawi: Sauti, Sagonja, Yizaso, Chamandanda); na kuzungusha mazao ili kuzuia ugonjwa kuongezeka kwenye udongo.
Source: Farm Radio International, "One head cannot lift a roof (Mutu umodzi susenza denga)" (scripts.farmradio.fm/radio-script/one-head-cannot-lift-a-roof-mutu-umodzi-susenza-denga/), Malawi cassava mosaic disease drama
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=Farm Radio International script; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Malawi; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.917

English: For a nutritious home-made feed for local chickens (about 8-10 months old), mix roughly: 40% maize or sorghum, 27% bran, 20% oilseed cake (sesame, cotton, or groundnut), plus smaller amounts of fish meal, salt, and mineral premix. Chickens raised on natural feed (not commercial feed with medication) fetch better prices from consumers.
Kiswahili: Kwa chakula chenye lishe cha kuku wa nyumbani (karibu miezi 8-10), changanya hivi: 40% mahindi au sorghum, 27% ya matope, 20% ya keki ya mafuta (sesamu, pamba, au karanga), pamoja na kiasi kidogo cha unga wa samaki, chumvi, na pre-mix ya madini. Kuku zilizolelewa kwa chakula cha asili (sio chakula cha kibiashara na dawa) huleta bei bora kutoka kwa watumiaji.
Source: Farm Radio International, "Preparing feed for local chickens in agroecological ways" (scripts.farmradio.fm/radio-script/preparing-feed-for-local-chickens-in-agroecological-ways/), Dodoma Region, Tanzania
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=Farm Radio International script; urgency=low; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Tanzania; qa_tool=nllb; qa_roundtrip=0.562

English: To store potatoes longer without them rotting or drying out, layer them with sawdust in a store (alternating layers of sawdust and potatoes, starting and ending with sawdust). The sawdust must be kept moist but not too wet - too dry and the potatoes shrivel and attract pests, too wet and they rot.
Kiswahili: Ili kuhifadhi viazi kwa muda mrefu bila kuoza au kukauka, ziweke na machujo ya mbao kwenye duka (tabaka zinazopishana za machujo ya mbao na viazi, kuanzia na kuishia na machujo ya mbao). Machujo ya mbao lazima yawekwe unyevu lakini sio mvua sana - kavu sana na viazi hunyauka na kuvutia wadudu, mvua sana na huoza.
Source: Farm Radio International, "Sawdust prolongs the storage life of potatoes" (scripts.farmradio.fm/radio-script/sawdust-prolongs-the-storage-life-of-potatoes/), Kenya
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=Farm Radio International script; urgency=low; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Kenya; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.705

English: To protect stored maize from weevils without chemicals: once cobs are fully dry, remove the kernels, pound the empty cobs into a fine powder, mix this with the kernels, and pack tightly into jute sacks. The powder blocks the weevils' movement so they cannot find new kernels to infest, protecting the maize for up to 12 months.
Kiswahili: Ili kulinda mahindi yaliyohifadhiwa kutoka kwa wadudu bila kemikali: mara tu mahindi yamekauka kabisa, ondoa punje, piga cobs tupu kwenye poda laini, changanya hii na punje, na pakia vizuri kwenye magunia ya jute. Poda huzuia harakati za wadudu kwa hivyo hawawezi kupata punje mpya za kushambulia, kulinda mahindi kwa hadi miezi 12.
Source: Farm Radio International, "Innovative farmer uses pounded maize cobs to protect stored maize" (scripts.farmradio.fm/radio-script/innovative-farmer-uses-pounded-maize-cobs-to-protect-stored-maize/), Benin
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=Farm Radio International script; urgency=low; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Benin; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.531

English: To control striga weed, pull it out by hand as soon as it starts flowering and before it produces new seeds; pull carefully so the stem doesn't break, then put the plants in a plastic bag and burn them immediately - do not leave them on the ground, as the tiny seeds will fall and spread. Combine hand-pulling with crop rotation and soil fertilization for better control.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti magugu ya striga, ivute kwa mkono mara tu inapoanza kuchanua na kabla ya kutoa mbegu mpya; Vuta kwa uangalifu ili shina lisivunjike, kisha weka mimea kwenye mfuko wa plastiki na uichome mara moja - usiwaache chini, kwani mbegu ndogo zitaanguka na kuenea. Changanya kuvuta kwa mkono na mzunguko wa mazao na mbolea ya udongo kwa udhibiti bora.
Source: Farm Radio International, "Remove Striga Weeds Carefully from your Field" (scripts.farmradio.fm/radio-script/remove-striga-weeds-carefully-from-your-field/)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=Farm Radio International script; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.745

English: To prevent coccidiosis and mycoplasmosis in poultry, cattle, sheep, and goats: raise feeding and watering troughs above the ground to stop contamination from droppings, and keep livestock sheds dry and clean, since humid, unhygienic conditions favour infection with both diseases.
Kiswahili: Ili kuzuia coccidiosis na mycoplasmosis katika kuku, ng'ombe, kondoo, na mbuzi: inua mabwawa ya kulisha na kumwagilia juu ya ardhi ili kuzuia uchafuzi kutoka kwa kinyesi, na kuweka mabanda ya mifugo kavu na safi, kwani hali ya unyevunyevu, isiyo safi inapendelea kuambukizwa na magonjwa yote mawili.
Source: Farm Radio International, "Managing livestock diseases: Mycoplasmosis and coccidiosis" (scripts.farmradio.fm/radio-script/managing-livestock-diseases-mycoplasmosis-and-coccidiosis/)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=Farm Radio International backgrounder; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.233

English: If you use improved fallows (planting a cover crop/shrub to rest and restore land) to improve soil fertility, remember to replace the phosphorus removed when you cut the shrubs before you plant your next crop - add compost or manure, or for best results apply a phosphate fertilizer (such as DAP, SSP, TSP, or rock phosphate).
Kiswahili: Ikiwa unatumia magugu yaliyoboreshwa (kupanda mazao ya kufunika/mimea ya miche ili kupumzika na kurudisha udongo) ili kuboresha uzazi wa udongo, kumbuka kuchukua nafasi ya fosforasi iliyotolewa unapokatua miche kabla ya kupanda mazao yako ya pili - ongeza mbolea au uchafu, au kwa matokeo bora tumia mbolea ya phosphate (kama vile DAP, SSP, TSP, au phosphate ya mwamba).
Source: Farm Radio International, "Farmers who use improved fallows must replace phosphorous in soils" (scripts.farmradio.fm/radio-script/farmers-who-use-improved-fallows-must-replace-phosphorous-in-soils/)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=Farm Radio International script; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; qa_tool=nllb; qa_roundtrip=0.619

English: As a free, locally-available pesticide for pests and diseases in beans, some farmers grind the leaves of Tephrosia vogelii (known locally by various names), soak them in water for several hours, filter the water, and spray it on both infected and healthy bean plants. Note this method hasn't been scientifically tested for safety, so use with care.
Kiswahili: Wakiwa huru, baadhi ya wakulima husaga majani ya Tephrosia vogelii (yajulikanayo kwa majina mbalimbali), hulowesha maji kwa muda wa saa kadhaa, huchuja maji, na kuyanyunyiza kwenye mimea iliyoambukizwa na inayofaa.
Source: Farm Radio International, "Women farmers use local methods to fight pests and diseases in beans" (scripts.farmradio.fm/radio-script/women-farmers-use-local-methods-to-fight-pests-and-diseases-in-beans/), Kigoma Region, Tanzania

English: Before planting, clear weeds and dig minimal-disturbance holes for seeds; while crops grow, use natural biopesticides first and chemical pesticides only for stubborn pests; add mulch, compost, and manure to boost soil fertility and retain moisture; and after harvest, rotate to an unrelated crop (for example, beans after maize) to improve soil health and reduce pests and diseases.
Kiswahili: Kabla ya kupanda, futa magugu na uchimbe mashimo ya usumbufu mdogo kwa mbegu; wakati mazao yanakua, tumia viuatilifu vya asili kwanza na dawa za kemikali tu kwa wadudu wakaidi; ongeza matandazo, mbolea, na mbolea ili kuongeza rutuba ya udongo na kuhifadhi unyevu; na baada ya kuvuna, zungusha kwa mazao yasiyohusiana (kwa mfano, maharagwe baada ya mahindi) ili kuboresha afya ya udongo na kupunguza wadudu na magonjwa.
Source: Farm Radio International, "Radio spots on circular and regenerative agriculture", Spot #1 (scripts.farmradio.fm/radio-script/radio-spots-on-circular-and-regenerative-agriculture/), Uganda
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=Farm Radio International radio spot; urgency=low; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Uganda; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.421

English: To improve soil fertility and get a source of firewood, plant Gliricidia sepium trees (grown from seed or stem cuttings) in alley rows alongside your crops - space trees 100cm apart within rows, with 5 metres between rows, to allow enough sunlight and easy pruning and harvesting.
Kiswahili: Ili kuboresha rutuba ya udongo na kupata chanzo cha kuni, panda miti ya sepium ya Gliricidia (iliyopandwa kutoka kwa vipandikizi vya mbegu au shina) katika safu za uchochoro kando ya mazao yako - weka miti 100cm mbali ndani ya safu, na mita 5 kati ya safu, ili kuruhusu mwanga wa jua wa kutosha na kupogoa na kuvuna kwa urahisi.
Source: Farm Radio International, "Plant Gliricidia sepium for soil fertility and fuelwood" (scripts.farmradio.fm/radio-script/plant-gliricidia-sepium-for-soil-fertility-and-fuelwood/), Eastern Province, Zambia
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=Farm Radio International script; urgency=low; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Zambia; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.825

English: During Uganda's May rains, farmers and communities are advised to monitor weather updates and early warnings, harvest rainwater to maximize agricultural production, secure roofs and structures before storms, and clear drainage channels to reduce flood damage to crops and property.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa mvua za Mei za Uganda, wakulima na jamii wanashauriwa kufuatilia sasisho za hali ya hewa na maonyo ya mapema, kuvuna maji ya mvua ili kuongeza uzalishaji wa kilimo, kulinda paa na miundo kabla ya dhoruba, na kusafisha mifereji ya maji ili kupunguza uharibifu wa mafuriko kwa mazao na mali.

English: To prevent maize downy mildew disease (locally called 'nanzikambe' in Chichewa): till the field deeply before planting, use certified seed from licensed sellers, avoid planting maize near sugarcane, use recommended plant spacing for good airflow, rotate maize with legume crops, and treat seed with Metalaxyl fungicide (6g per kg of seed).
Kiswahili: Ili kuzuia ugonjwa wa ukungu wa mahindi (unaojulikana Malawi kama 'nanzikambe'): lima shamba kwa kina kabla ya kupanda, tumia mbegu zilizothibitishwa kutoka kwa wauzaji walioidhinishwa, epuka kupanda mahindi karibu na miwa, panda kwa nafasi inayopendekezwa ili hewa ipite vizuri, badilisha mahindi na mazao ya jamii ya mikunde, na tibu mbegu kwa dawa ya kuvu ya Metalaxyl (gramu 6 kwa kilo ya mbegu).
Source: Malawi Ministry of Agriculture, "Kuzindikira ndi kulimbana ndi matenda a nanzikambe mu chimanga" [Recognizing and fighting downy mildew disease in maize], dodma.gov.mw/newssingle/3

English: If your maize is infected with downy mildew disease: uproot and bury infected plants promptly, avoid walking through infected areas to prevent spreading the disease, remove volunteer sorghum shoots from the field, and after harvest burn or bury crop residues from affected fields; consult your nearest agricultural extension officer for more guidance.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mahindi yako yameshambuliwa na ugonjwa wa ukungu (nanzikambe): ng'oa na uzike mimea iliyoathirika mara moja, epuka kutembea kwenye maeneo yaliyoathirika ili kuzuia kuenea kwa ugonjwa, ondoa machipukizi ya mtama yanayojitokeza yenyewe shambani, na baada ya mavuno choma au zika mabaki ya mazao kutoka mashamba yaliyoathirika; wasiliana na afisa ugani wa kilimo aliye karibu nawe kwa ushauri zaidi.
Source: Malawi Ministry of Agriculture, "Kuzindikira ndi kulimbana ndi matenda a nanzikambe mu chimanga" [Recognizing and fighting downy mildew disease in maize], dodma.gov.mw/newssingle/3

English: To avoid buying counterfeit maize seed, look for the scratch-code sticker on the seed packet, scratch it, and send the code to the toll-free verification number to confirm authenticity before planting - as KEPHIS Deputy Director for Seed Certification Ephraim Wachira put it, 'This sticker is what helps farmers distinguish between genuine and fake seed.'
Kiswahili: Ili kuepuka kununua mbegu ghushi za mahindi, tafuta kibandiko cha msimbo wa mwanzo kwenye pakiti ya mbegu, uikwaruze, na utume msimbo kwa nambari ya uthibitishaji isiyolipishwa ili kuthibitisha uhalisi kabla ya kupanda - kama Naibu Mkurugenzi wa KEPHIS wa Udhibitisho wa Mbegu Ephraim Wachira alivyosema, 'Kibandiko hiki ndicho kinachowasaidia wakulima kutofautisha kati ya mbegu halisi na bandia.'
Source: The Standard, "Farmers risk losing half their harvest, agency warns" (standardmedia.co.ke/counties/article/2001547918), quoting KEPHIS Deputy Director for Seed Certification Ephraim Wachira
Metadata: tone=warning; platform=news article with direct agency quote; urgency=high; translation=team; source_lang=en; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.348

English: To manage bacterial wilt in enset, sterilize cutting tools with 70% alcohol or bleach (or heat them until red-hot) before and after each plant, dig out and bury diseased plants deep in a pit, use disease-free seedlings, rotate with cereal or pulse crops (not banana), and fence the field to keep out animals that can spread the disease.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti kuharibika kwa bakteria katika enset, sterilize zana za kukata na 70% ya pombe au bleach (au joto yao hadi moto nyekundu) kabla na baada ya kila mmea, kuchimba nje na kuzikwa mimea wagonjwa kina kirefu katika shimo, kutumia mbegu zisizo na ugonjwa, kugeuka na nafaka au pulse mazao (si banana), na fence shamba ili kuweka nje wanyama ambao wanaweza kueneza ugonjwa.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Controlling bacterial wilt of enset using cultural methods", Created in Ethiopia, August 2014, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20157800326.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Ethiopia; qa_tool=nllb; qa_roundtrip=0.419

English: To manage groundnut rosette disease, plant early with the first good rains (late planting attracts more aphids that spread the virus), use the correct plant spacing, plant resistant varieties (in Malawi: Nsinjilo, Chalimbana 2005, Chitala, Baka), and uproot and destroy (burn or bury) infected plants.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti ugonjwa wa rosette ya karanga, panda mapema na mvua nzuri ya kwanza (upandaji wa marehemu huvutia aphids zaidi zinazoeneza virusi), tumia nafasi sahihi ya mimea, aina zinazostahimili mimea (nchini Malawi: Nsinjilo, Chalimbana 2005, Chitala, Baka), na kung'oa na kuharibu (kuchoma au kuzika) mimea iliyoambukizwa.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Management of Rosette in Groundnuts", Created in Malawi, July 2013, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20167800237.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Malawi; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.338

English: To control fruit flies in mango orchards, make simple traps from small plastic containers with a hanging cotton wick, drench the wick with a 10-20% pesticide solution (such as malathion, fenthion, or deltamethrin) plus a lure like methyl eugenol, and hang the traps in and around the orchard - flies are attracted by the lure and killed by the pesticide.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti nzi wa matunda kwenye bustani za embe, tengeneza mitego rahisi kutoka kwa vyombo vidogo vya plastiki na utambi wa pamba unaoning'inia, loweka utambi na suluhisho la dawa ya 10-20% (kama vile malathion, fenthion, au deltamethrin) pamoja na chambo kama methyl eugenol, na utundike mitego ndani na karibu na bustani - nzi huvutiwa na kivutio na kuuawa na dawa ya wadudu.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Management of fruit flies in mangoes using traps", Created in Malawi, August 2014, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20167800330.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Malawi; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.488

English: Banana Xanthomonas wilt is not yet in Ghana, but if you spot it: immediately uproot infected plants, cut them into pieces and bury deep away from the farm; remove the male bud with a forked stick (not a cutlass) before it opens; disinfect farm tools with 10% bleach or fire; and never take planting material (suckers) from an infected farm.
Kiswahili: Mnyauko wa ndizi Xanthomonas bado haujawa Ghana, lakini ukiiona: mara moja kung'oa mimea iliyoambukizwa, ikate vipande vipande na uzike mbali kabisa na shamba; ondoa bud ya kiume na fimbo iliyopigwa (sio cutlass) kabla ya kufungua; disinfect zana za shamba na 10% bleach au moto; na kamwe usichukue nyenzo za kupanda (suckers) kutoka kwa shamba lililoambukizwa.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "How to Recognise Banana Xanthomonas Wilt", Created in Ghana, May 2016, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20167800917.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=high; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Ghana; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.364

English: To limit the spread of eucalyptus gall wasp, never transport or distribute seedlings from an infected nursery to disease-free areas, remove and burn affected plant parts and fallen leaves (especially September-November), and be aware that registered chemical treatments for this pest are not yet available in Ethiopia.
Kiswahili: Ili kupunguza kuenea kwa nyumbu ya gall ya eucalyptus, kamwe usafirishe au usambaze miche kutoka kwa kiota cha watoto kilichoambukizwa kwenda maeneo yasiyo na magonjwa, ondoa na kuchoma sehemu za mimea iliyoathiriwa na majani yaliyoanguka (haswa Septemba-Novemba), na ujue kuwa matibabu ya kemikali yaliyoorodheshwa kwa wadudu hawa bado hayapatikani Ethiopia.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Eucalyptus gall wasp (Blue gum chalcid)", Created in Ethiopia, October 2015, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20167801209.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=low; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Ethiopia; qa_tool=nllb; qa_roundtrip=0.691

English: To manage boron deficiency in pawpaw, apply 5-10kg of well-decomposed manure per plant annually at the start of the rainy season, and apply 0.5-5g of Borax fertilizer around the base of young plants; for mature plants, a foliar spray of water-soluble boron corrects the deficiency faster than soil application.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti upungufu wa boroni katika pawpaw, tumia 5-10kg ya mbolea iliyoharibika vizuri kwa kila mmea kila mwaka mwanzoni mwa msimu wa mvua, na tumia 0.5-5g ya mbolea ya Borax karibu na msingi wa mimea ya vijana; kwa mimea ya kukomaa, dawa ya majani ya boroni ya maji huondoa upungufu haraka kuliko matumizi ya udongo.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Prevention of boron deficiency in pawpaw", Created in Malawi, July 2018, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20197800173.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=low; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Malawi; qa_tool=nllb; qa_roundtrip=0.394

English: Plant certified seeds using the correct planting methods - as KALRO Director Robert Musyoki puts it, this is 'the best way' to address Kenya's food deficit; certified seeds 'guarantee improved productivity and resilience,' according to KALRO Research Officer Samuel Kiiru.
Kiswahili: Panda mbegu zilizoidhinishwa kwa kutumia njia sahihi za kupanda - kama Mkurugenzi wa KALRO Robert Musyoki anavyosema, hii ndiyo 'njia bora' ya kushughulikia upungufu wa chakula nchini Kenya; mbegu zilizoidhinishwa 'zinahakikisha tija na uthabiti,' kulingana na Afisa Utafiti wa KALRO Samuel Kiiru.

English: To control nematodes in tomatoes without chemicals, plant Red Sunhemp (2kg seed per lima) in the field 3-3.5 months before growing tomatoes - its roots release a chemical that repels nematodes. Remove or plough in the Sunhemp plants after harvesting their seed, then plant your tomatoes.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti nematodes katika nyanya bila kemikali, panda Red Sunhemp (mbegu ya kilo 2 kwa lima) shambani miezi 3-3.5 kabla ya kukua nyanya - mizizi yake hutoa kemikali ambayo hufukuza nematodes. Ondoa au lima kwenye mimea ya Sunhemp baada ya kuvuna mbegu zao, kisha panda nyanya zako.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Red Sunhemp against nematodes in tomatoes", Created in Zambia, August 2013, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20147801411.pdf)

English: To manage black Sigatoka in bananas, check your field weekly from planting until the tree matures. If you see an infected leaf, cut it carefully, bag it, and burn or bury it away from the field; if a whole tree is badly infected, cut it down and destroy it immediately. Always clean your tools with ethanol, bleach, or fire between uses.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti Sigatoka nyeusi katika ndizi, angalia shamba lako kila wiki tangu kupanda hadi mti ukomavu. Ikiwa unaona jani lenye maambukizi, likatikane kwa uangalifu, lifungue, na ulichome au ulilifiche mbali na shamba; ikiwa mti mzima umeambukizwa vibaya, ukate na kuharibu mara moja. Daima safisha zana zako kwa ethanol, beluch, au moto kati ya matumizi.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Reducing Black Sigatoka in your Banana field", Created in Congo (DRC), May 2014, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20157800101.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=DR Congo; qa_tool=nllb; qa_roundtrip=0.03

English: To protect stored maize from insect pests using an airtight metal silo: load only clean, dry maize (13% moisture or less), place a lit candle inside on a tray, then seal the silo. The candle burns up the oxygen and goes out on its own (5-20 minutes), and the resulting low-oxygen environment kills the insects without chemicals.
Kiswahili: Ili kulinda mahindi yaliyohifadhiwa dhidi ya wadudu wadudu kwa kutumia silo ya chuma isiyopitisha hewa: pakia mahindi safi tu, kavu (unyevu 13% au chini), weka mshumaa uliowashwa ndani kwenye trei, kisha uzibe silo. Mshumaa huchoma oksijeni na kwenda peke yake (dakika 5-20), na mazingira ya chini ya oksijeni huua wadudu bila kemikali.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Grain storage in metal silos against insect pests", Created in Zambia, July 2014, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20157800264.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=low; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Zambia; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.787

English: To manage bacterial black spot in mango, prune off and destroy diseased twigs (sterilizing your tools between cuts), spray copper oxychloride-based products as soon as the disease appears nearby - before it infects your trees. Avoid spraying during fruit set, and do not enter the orchard for at least a day after spraying.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti doa nyeusi la bakteria kwenye embe, kata na uharibu matawi yenye ugonjwa (kusafisha zana zako kati ya kupunguzwa), nyunyiza bidhaa za oksikloridi ya shaba mara tu ugonjwa unapoonekana karibu - kabla ya kuambukiza miti yako. Epuka kunyunyizia dawa wakati wa kuweka matunda, na usiingie kwenye bustani kwa angalau siku baada ya kunyunyizia dawa.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Copper against bacterial black spot in mango", Created in Zambia, December 2014, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20167800022.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Zambia; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.473

English: To control mango pulp weevil, harvest fruits earlier than usual (before fully ripe), and remove and bury fallen fruit debris at least 50cm deep (or compost it under at least 1m of other material) to stop weevils hatching and reinfesting the crop.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti weevil ya massa ya embe, vuna matunda mapema kuliko kawaida (kabla ya kuiva kabisa), na uondoe na uzike uchafu wa matunda ulioanguka kwa kina cha angalau 50cm (au uiweke mbolea chini ya angalau 1m ya nyenzo zingine) ili kuzuia wadudu kuanguliwa na kurejesha mazao.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Cultural control of mango pulp weevil", Created in Zambia, July 2015, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20167800147.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=low; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Zambia; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.801

English: To control anthracnose in African eggplant, buy a Mancozeb-based fungicide from a registered agro-dealer (avoid Mancozeb-Metalaxyl mixes), mix 40g per 20 litres of water plus 2 tablespoons of liquid soap as a sticker, and spray mid-morning or late afternoon avoiding wind and drought-stressed plants; observe a two-week pre-harvest interval.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti anthracnose katika biringanya ya Kiafrika, nunua dawa ya kuua kuvu inayotokana na Mancozeb kutoka kwa muuzaji wa kilimo aliyesajiliwa (epuka mchanganyiko wa Mancozeb-Metalaxyl), changanya 40g kwa lita 20 za maji pamoja na vijiko 2 vya sabuni ya maji kama kibandiko, na nyunyiza katikati ya asubuhi au alasiri kuepuka mimea inayofadhaika kwa upepo na ukame; Zingatia muda wa wiki mbili kabla ya mavuno.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Protect African eggplant from anthracnose", Created in Zambia, September 2014, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20167800027.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Zambia; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.723

English: To control powdery mildew in okra without synthetic chemicals, pound 1.5kg of fresh neem leaves and soak in 16 litres of water for 24 hours, sieve, add 50g of soft soap as a sticker, then spray the whole plant, repeating after 2 weeks if symptoms persist. Stop spraying 10-14 days before harvest.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti ukungu wa unga kwenye bamia bila kemikali za syntetisk, pauni kilo 1.5 za majani safi ya mwarobaini na loweka kwenye lita 16 za maji kwa masaa 24, ungo, ongeza 50g ya sabuni laini kama kibandiko, kisha nyunyiza mmea mzima, ukirudia baada ya wiki 2 ikiwa dalili zitaendelea. Acha kunyunyizia siku 10-14 kabla ya kuvuna.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Neem extract to control powdery mildew in okra", Created in Zambia, September 2016, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20177800425.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=low; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Zambia; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.722

English: To control Kapinga (Bermuda grass) in maize fields, spray glyphosate on actively growing weeds a few days after rain (240ml per 16L water) before planting, then plant maize a day or more later; before or after maize germinates, spray Atrazine over moist soil (320ml per 16L water). Always follow label instructions and wear protective equipment.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti Kapinga (nyasi za Bermuda) katika mashamba ya mahindi, nyunyiza glyphosate kwenye magugu yanayokua kikamilifu siku chache baada ya mvua (240ml kwa maji 16L) kabla ya kupanda, kisha panda mahindi siku moja au zaidi baadaye; kabla au baada ya mahindi kuota, nyunyiza Atrazine juu ya udongo wenye unyevunyevu (320ml kwa maji 16L). Daima fuata maagizo ya lebo na uvaa vifaa vya kinga.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Kapinga management with herbicides in maize", Created in Zambia, July 2017, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20177801256.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Zambia; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.858

English: Ahead of a forecast dry spell, Kenya's Meteorological Department and agriculture ministry advise crop farmers to heavily mulch their fields, practice minimum tillage, construct tied ridges, and invest in rainwater harvesting structures to conserve soil moisture.
Kiswahili: Kabla ya kipindi cha ukame kinachotabiriwa, Idara ya Hali ya Hewa na wizara ya kilimo ya Kenya wanawashauri wakulima wa mashamba yao waweke mashamba mengi, wafanye kazi ya kulima, wajenge vilima vilivyofungwa, na wawekeze katika miundo ya kukusanya maji ya mvua ili kuhifadhi unyevu wa udongo.

English: Ahead of a forecast dry spell, livestock keepers - especially in Kenya's arid and semi-arid areas - are advised to conserve existing fodder, manage water supplies carefully, and shield animals from temperature extremes.
Kiswahili: Hapo awali, walinzi wa mifugo, hasa katika maeneo yenye ukame ya Kenya, wanashauriwa wahifadhi chakula cha mifugo, wasimamie maji kwa uangalifu, na kulinda wanyama kutokana na joto kali.
Source: Kenya Meteorological Department, monthly climate advisory reported in "Farmers Told to Conserve Moisture as Kenya Met Predicts Cold, Dry Conditions Throughout July" (kenyans.co.ke/news/124954)

English: Harvest tomatoes in the early morning or late evening when the temperature is around 20C and the weather is dry.
